snippet.title: Tex Murphy: Under a killing moon Remake Chandler Avenue Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
A Teaser Trailer for the upcoming Kickstarter to the remake of Tex Murphy: Under a killing moon.
Please subscribe on the website to get updates and a Kickstarter launch Email for day 1 backing.
And please share share share!
https://www.killingmoonrising.com

Music by Piper Dawes
